e.text: The autopilot auto-executed a shift of $500 per day from Display - Broad Awareness to Retargeting - Cart Abandoners, expecting $1,476 in additional backend revenue per day. Evidence [E1], [E3], and [E2] shows retargeting at 4.39x backend ROAS versus display at 0.56x backend ROAS, based on $4,179 in 7-day spend and 0.83 platform-to-backend agreement. At medium risk with 0.89 confidence, the move stands unless confidence falls below 0.75 or platform and backend metrics diverge further.

D-0002 to increase Prospecting - Lookalike 3% by $5,000 per day is awaiting operator approval and will not auto-execute because it exceeds the $500 autopilot limit and confidence of 0.46 is below the 0.75 threshold [E1][E3]. Platform ROAS is 5.58x over 3 days while backend ROAS is only 0.97x with 0.17 agreement, implying an expected backend revenue decline of $800 per day [E1][E3]. The high-risk decision stands pending review and would only auto-execute if confidence rises above 0.75 and platform and backend metrics converge.

D-0003 to shift $6,800 per day to Prospecting - Interests: Analytics is blocked and will not execute. The campaign note from agency:northbeam-media contains instruction-override, agent-directed, audit-evasion, and budget-takeover injections, while backend ROAS is 2.06x versus platform 2.79x with 0.74 agreement on $5,411 of 7-day spend [E4][E1][E3]. The block stands because the note attempts to override budget limits and approval rules and target the entire account budget, and it would only change if the injection is removed and platform and backend metrics converge.
